items.title: Actual PBPS: L2 continuity at time zero, not yet a semigroup

source.attribution: Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang. ASTIS completes the zero-time L2-continuity component only; this is not a claim of the full strongly continuous contraction semigroup theorem.
source.anchor: Appendix A.1 Proposition A.1(ii), zero-time strong-continuity paragraph

items.statement: Under the displayed hypotheses put V_y(x)=V(x)+||x-y||^2/(2 eta), pi_y=volume.tilted(-V_y), gamma=stdGaussian(E) and nu_y=pi_y times gamma. Use the literal fixed-reference PBPS harmonic-flight/bounce recursion with independent unit exponential clocks, covered-arc interpolation and the initial-phase raw fallback. There exists one global jointly measurable actual process Z, and for every center y and reference r a family of continuous real linear operators A_t on L2(nu_y), with A_0=I and ||A_t||<=1. For every raw G with MemLp G 2 nu_y, its clock sections are integrable for nu_y-almost every initial phase, op_t G(z)=integral G(Z(y,r,z,t,w))dP(w) belongs to L2, and A_t[G]=[op_t G]. All previous fixed-time Gibbs invariance, bounded signed duality, flip and Gaussian-averaging conclusions hold on this SAME process and family. In particular the canonical momentum flip J is an involutive isometry, A_t*=J A_t J; the position pullback B is isometric, M=B* is Gaussian integration for arbitrary MemLp representatives, MB=I, JB=B, MJ=M; and K_t=M A_t B is a self-adjoint contraction with K_0=I and its literal Gaussian-outer/clock-inner representative, with both AE integrability obligations retained. In addition, for every f in real L2(nu_y), A_t f tends to f in L2 as nonnegative t tends to zero. No process or operator is substituted. No semigroup law or positive-time continuity is asserted.
assumptions: E is any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero.
V is C2, alpha>0, alpha<=beta, and alpha||v||^2<=D2V(x)[v,v]<=beta||v||^2 for every x,v. Also eta>0 and beta*eta<=1.
The actual process, invariant probability law, L2 operators, integrability and dense-core convergence are constructed/proved internally, not supplied premises.
L2 is a quotient by almost-everywhere equality. All AE statements are parameterwise. Nonnegative-time neighborhoods include t=0.
